title: Cloned value equals bounded-table value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, let a tester have a finite seed space with a probability law and a sign-valued query check at each seed, and let $M$ be a positive integer. For any sign assignment to pairs consisting of a vertex-query pair and a clone, the value of the cloned long-code constraint experiment equals the tester's acceptance probability averaged over vertices when each vertex's bounded function is the mean sign of its $M$ clones at each query.
hypotheses_covered: A positive integer clone count M
A sign assignment on (vertex, query) pairs and clone indices
